definitions.explanation: wind blowing from the sea, often carrying the scent of salt

examples.japanese: {潮風|しおかぜ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気持|きも}ちいい→気持ちいい：09583_kimochiii⟧。
{潮風|しおかぜ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たり→当たる：01860_ataru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}する→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧。
examples.english: To take a walk while enjoying the sea breeze.

examples.japanese: {潮風|しおかぜ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{錆|さ}び→錆びる：07412_sabiru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Cars rust easily due to the salty sea air.

notes:
{潮風|しおかぜ} evokes the atmosphere of coastal areas.

WRITING:
- ⟦{潮|しお}→潮：13369_shio⟧ (tide, sea water, salt water)
- ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧ (wind, breeze)

CHARACTERISTICS:
- Carries the scent of salt (⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧)
- Often described as refreshing (⟦{爽|さわ}やか→爽やか：05701_sawayaka⟧)
- Can cause rust and corrosion due to salt content

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {潮風|しおかぜ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧ (to be exposed to the sea breeze)
- {潮風|しおかぜ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel the sea breeze)
- {潮風|しおかぜ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧ (the scent of the sea breeze)

POETIC USAGE:
Often used in literature and poetry to evoke seaside settings and nostalgia.

RELATED WORDS:
- {海風|うみかぜ}/{海風|かいふう} (sea wind)
- {浜風|はまかぜ} (beach wind)
- ⟦{磯|いそ}→磯：05389_iso⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧ (scent of the shore)
